title: SharedTariffGroup
description: A many-to-many grouping of licensees that share a common commission-approved tariff schedule or ceiling tariff, e.g. multiple state DISCOMs on one MYT order, or a deemed licensee adopting another licensee's approved ceiling tariff. See docs/data/INDIA_CI_TARIFF_DATA_STRATEGY.md section 5.1 and registry/shared_tariff_groups.yaml.

regulator_code.description: Code from regulators.yaml that approves the shared schedule.

jurisdiction_codes.description: Jurisdiction codes (jurisdictions.yaml) covered by this shared group, when it spans more than one (e.g. a JERC-approved schedule).

licensee_codes.description: Codes from licensees.yaml that share this tariff schedule.

basis.description: Why the licensees are grouped: one order applying to several DISCOMs, a deemed licensee adopting another's ceiling tariff, a single UT electricity department, or a JERC-approved common schedule across jurisdictions.
